motions.item_title: Approve the minutes of July 28, 2026, Planning Commission meeting with the correction of adding…
motions.motion: Commissioner Strong moved to approve the minutes of July 28, 2026, Planning Commission meeting with the correction of adding Commissioner Hess to Item 7.A. as the Commissioner who made the motion. Commissioner Hess seconded the motion.
motions.headline: July 28 minutes approved with a correction
motions.summary: The commission approved its July 28, 2026 minutes after fixing the record to show Commissioner Hess made the motion on Item 7.A.
motions.impact: A correction to the written record of a past meeting. It touches the file the city keeps and nothing you will encounter.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Pinnacles Rezone and Master Development Pl…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Pinnacles Rezone and Master Development Plan Agreement Amendment. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Pinnacles zoning change sent to the council
motions.summary: The commission asked the City Council to approve the Pinnacles zoning change and an amendment to the master development plan agreement for the site.
motions.impact: Nothing changes on the ground yet. The council holds the final vote and can decide otherwise, so if you live near the Pinnacles site, that is the meeting to watch.
